correctness.rationale: The upper bound is an explicit supremum-product embedding by star metrics. The lower bound uses the tree four-point condition to show that distance-two pairs from distinct non-singleton parts require distinct coordinates, and midpoint uniqueness to show that at least two singleton parts require one additional coordinate. Boundary cases agree with known examples.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The closest 2026 source proves the complete-bipartite case and a perfect-matching-deletion family but does not state a complete-multipartite formula. Searches of exact, synonymous, and equivalent formulations found no stronger coverage. An older tropical notion called tree rank was checked and is explicitly distinguished from the Pachter-Sturmfels notion. Residual risk remains because the original Pachter-Sturmfels book section was not inspected in full and the 2026 source is very recent.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact formula for a classical graph class, unifies two previously treated complete-multipartite subfamilies, extends the perfect-matching example to arbitrary matching deletion, and supplies a structural family relevant to bounded-rank classification.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
